newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Police suspect Taiwan fugitive on hideout in China masterminding kidnap-murder of teenage daughter of popular actress Pai Ping-ping
-- China offers to send Taiwanese hijacker back to Taiwan on May 14
UNITED DAILY NEWS -President Lee Teng-hui claims kidnap-murder case is politicalised
-- National Police Administration chief Yao Kao-chiao speculated to be replaced over deteriorating law and order
LIBERTY TIMES - China to repatriate Taiwan hijacker on May 14
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Kidnap-murder case said to affect property market
-- Taiwan, Hong Kong to start shippling link talks on Friday
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - More Taiwan firms seen to seek new tax evasion base after Hong Kong reverts to China's sovereignty
-- Taiwan financial markets close for Labour Day holiday
